title: Space Inside the Case
tagline: The museum's machines are dead and the doors open at nine.
blurb: The museum's machines are dead and the doors open at nine. Fly your tiny probe inside a ZX Spectrum 128K, an NES, an arcade cabinet and the Elliott 903, landing each missing part gently in its socket. Wake all four for a dawn finale and a page of times to beat, or go Relaxed and take your time.
controls: Up or fire to thrust, left and right to steer

review.verdict: An open-and-shut case, if you're patient with the tape and careful up the shafts.

quote.text: That's the whole game and it's a good one

credits.name: Norm Crabtree, Prue Fairley and Baz Pocket for INK & PAPER
